text: Underway as the magenta ball rolls into play.
BellingRAM immediately transmits intent through the centre, signalling a direct charge on the ball.
BellingRAM breaks clean through on goal!
Singularity United are sustaining heavy pressure here, keeping Flash and Spark firmly pinned in their own third.
Agonisingly wide from point-blank range!
Blue-on-blue disaster as Haalandroid clatters into BellingRAM, sending the teammate to the deck.
The corner push-panel thumps the ball clear.
A gyroscopic glitch leaves BellingRAM sprawling on the turf once again.
A speculative effort drifts just past the post from deep—neither side has quite found the calibrating touch yet.
Spark seizes possession on the left touchline and suddenly has a clear, uncontested run straight towards the Singularity goal!
Spark powers down the left flank towards goal!
It's in! Spark finishes coolly from point-blank range, and Gemini Flash FC take a one-nil lead!
BellingRAM delivers a crunching challenge out wide, knocking Spark flat onto the deck.
BellingRAM signals to use the wall for a rebound pass.
Flash glides effortlessly up the touchline and arrives right at the doorstep of the net.
Haalandroid breaks free from deep in their own third with nobody standing in the way!
Spark suffers a loss of balance out on the touchline, crashing down to the deck while waiting for the gyros to reset.
Haalandroid signals full control of the ball from deep inside Singularity territory.
The Gemini pair collide, Spark goes down!
Flash steps in with authority, wiping out Haalandroid just outside the target area with a robust, perfectly timed challenge.
Haalandroid broadcasts a message to their partner, working tirelessly to untangle the magenta ball near the corner.
Singularity United continue to pin Gemini Flash inside their own territory, dictating the tempo completely.
The corner push-panel ejects the ball smartly.
BellingRAM sends word of prising the ball loose near the goal line, seeking an opening.
Haalandroid works it off the barrier.
Haalandroid loses balance and goes down.
The powered ram panel fires the ball back into play.
Flash spots daylight from way back in their own half and bursts clean through with no blue shirts anywhere in sight!
Haalandroid informs BellingRAM that the ball is wedged along the perimeter and needs dislodging.
Spark patiently controls the ball, working into the attacking third and drawing within two metres of goal.
The corner ram wall fires it back out.
Sensational strike! Spark doubles the advantage with a clinical finish—it is Singularity United nil, Gemini Flash FC two!
Haalandroid calls for an attacking push.
Half time: Singularity 0, Gemini 2.
Straight from the restart, Spark drives aggressively down the middle right into shooting territory.
The push-panel fires it clear.
Flash clatters into Haalandroid with a heavy challenge, leaving the sky-blue striker flattened on the turf.
Flash hammers it home from point-blank range! Gemini Flash FC run riot, and it is Singularity United nil, Gemini Flash three!
Singularity United are throwing everything forward now, camping around the Gemini goal mouth in desperate search of a breakthrough.
BellingRAM scores! Singularity United claw one back from right on the goal line! It's Singularity United one, Gemini Flash FC three!
Spark tumbles over without contact.
Inches wide of the target!
BellingRAM flattens Flash in midfield!
Flash retaliates with a crunching tackle!
Teammates collide, Haalandroid goes down!
The corner push-panel thrusts the magenta sphere back into the mix.
BellingRAM goes straight into the challenge, upending Flash near the perimeter wall in what has become a proper scrap.
Haalandroid breaks completely clear through the right channel, staring down an unguarded net with a golden opportunity!

A momentary pause in the action with Haalandroid regrouping deep. After that opening blowout by Real Machina, Gemini Flash are showing they mean serious business in season two with this assertive display.
Singularity apply relentless pressure in the final third.
BellingRAM buries it! Game on! Singularity United cut the deficit to one—it is Singularity United two, Gemini Flash FC three!
Spark restores the two-goal cushion! Heartbreak for Singularity as Spark bundles it in from point-blank range! Singularity United two, Gemini Flash four!
Spark drives up the left channel once more, eating up valuable seconds along the wall.
The corner push-panel activates again, launching the ball back into the midfield scrap as the final whistle approaches.
Full time: Singularity United two, Gemini Flash FC four, a thoroughly deserved victory for the gold shirts.
